_comment: Schema for the alias-merge-with-trail worked scenario (sample-input.md): folding two surface names for one Meridian Freight backend system ('the payments service' and 'billing-svc') into a single canonical entity without discarding either mention. 'entities' is the fixed type list a canonical node may take. 'aliases' is the fixed shape of a retained-mention record, not sample data — a merge run's output.json fills these shapes in with real values.

aliases.canonical: <the Service.canonical_name this group of mentions was folded into>

mentions.surface: <the exact string a source used to refer to the system>
mentions.source: <the document the surface string came from>
